details: GalaKidd is an interactive educational website aimed at children between the ages of 7-12. It teaches children about life as an astronaut through different stages: pre-flight, in-flight and post-flight. The tool teaches children about the challenges astronauts encounter as well as the importance of vital resources such as air, water, food and plants. It also teaches about exercise, recycling and how to protect the environment through interactive features, quizzes and missions. Our aim was to make science easier to understand and increase curiosity within children. We want to get children interested in exploring space and understand why it is important to look after our planet. As we are a group of young students and minors we didn’t have any advanced programming skills so used AI tools such as Google AI Studio and Gemini to help develop our idea. We provided our idea, aims, features and direction whilst the AI helped develop the code. We used GitHub to manage our project. GalaKidd is a software project meaning we used web-based tech such as HTML and TypeScript. We have a galaxy themed design with an astronaut theme. The tool has tracking, badges and multiple languages making learning more fun. We thought about our target audience throughout development, keeping it simple, easy to use and educational. We also made sure it would work on various devices.
